# Portable runtime packages (`dist/`)

| Directory | Status | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `linux-x64/` | VERIFIED | Reference portable package (`./tools/package_portable.sh linux-x64`) |
| `linux-arm64/` | BUILD-READY / NOT YET TESTED | Stub until native aarch64 packaging succeeds |
| `windows-x64/` | PLANNED / NOT YET TESTED | Stub; native MSVC host required |
| `macos-x64/` | PLANNED / NOT YET TESTED | Stub; native macOS host required |
| `macos-arm64/` | PLANNED / NOT YET TESTED | Stub; native macOS host required |
| `macos/` | legacy pointer | Prefer `macos-x64` / `macos-arm64` |

Packages are generated by `tools/package_portable.sh`. Unsupported targets refuse
to invent binaries.

Architecture details: `docs/MULTIPLATFORM_BUILD_ARCHITECTURE.md`.
